highlights: The AI landscape is seeing rapid advancements in open-weight Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, offering greater scale and context windows for diverse applications, including long-horizon agentic work.

Significant progress is being made in AI agent robustness, with new open-source sandboxing tools and runtime amendment frameworks emerging to enhance security, reliability, and continuous learning capabilities.

Major AI platforms like Google and OpenAI are expanding their enterprise adoption strategies, delivering frontier models and specialized support, particularly for academic research and complex industry solutions.

agents.title: Perplexity Open-Sources SPACE Sandbox for AI Agents
agents.summary: Perplexity has open-sourced SPACE, a production-tested Firecracker microVM sandbox designed for AI agents, offering robust isolation and controlled execution environments for developers building agent-based systems.

agents.title: CopilotKit Releases CLiF: Continual Learning Platform for Agents
agents.summary: CopilotKit launched CLiF, a platform enabling AI agents to continually learn by transforming agent traces and user actions into reusable skills, evaluations, and fine-tuning data, crucial for scaling complex agentic workflows.

agents.title: ARIA: Runtime Inspection and Amendment for Multi-Agent Systems
agents.summary: ARIA is a new framework that enables learning when and how to repair ongoing multi-agent executions, addressing critical reliability challenges by turning execution-verified repairs into reusable, learned intervention policies for complex MAS.

models.title: Google Introduces Gemini 4 Argon: Frontier Model for Hard Problems
models.summary: Google has released Gemini 4 Argon, its latest frontier model, providing developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers with advanced capabilities to solve their most challenging problems.

models.title: Meta Releases Muse Spark Open: 816B Open-Weight MoE with 1M Context
models.summary: Meta introduced Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter open-weight Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model featuring 42B active parameters and a 1M-token context, designed to lead open models in performance and efficiency.

models.title: StepFun Releases Step 5 Preview Open Weights: 600B MoE, 1M Context
models.summary: StepFun launched Step 5 Preview as open weights, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 600B total parameters, 27B active, and up to 1M tokens of context, specifically built for long-horizon agentic work.

tools.title: Temporal Specification Guidance for Text-to-Video Generation
tools.summary: A new training-free, inference-time framework called Temporal Specification Guidance (TSG) uses formal Temporal Logic to turn explicit requirements into executable objectives, enhancing control over video generation during sampling.

tools.title: AutoSynthData: Generating Training Data for Enterprise Agents
tools.summary: Hugging Face announced AutoSynthData, a tool designed to generate high-quality synthetic training data for enterprise AI agents, streamlining development and improving agent performance in business environments.

tools.title: AlphaDiana: Measurement System for Agents in Verifiable Reasoning Tasks
tools.summary: AlphaDiana provides a modular measurement system for AI agents, enabling detailed analysis of their performance, behavior, and resource usage in verifiable reasoning tasks, crucial for diagnosing failures and improving agent design.

companies.title: OpenAI Brings GPT-Rosalind to Academic Research Labs
companies.summary: OpenAI is introducing the Rosalind Academic Plan, offering eligible academic labs sponsored access to GPT-Rosalind and associated tools, aimed at significantly advancing life sciences research.

companies.title: Google Beam Expands with New Regions, Partners, and Customers
companies.summary: Google's Beam platform is expanding its reach to five new countries and forming new partnerships, demonstrating significant growth in its services and infrastructure for AI and technology solutions.

companies.title: Itaú Builds Generative AI for Entire Customer Base with OpenAI
companies.summary: Itaú, a leading financial institution, is implementing a comprehensive AI-first strategy by deploying generative AI solutions like 'ia.i' and 'IARA' across its customer base, even in Brazil's highly regulated banking sector.

learning.title: OpenAI Supports Teaching Students to Think and Learn Through Questions
learning.summary: OpenAI is promoting 'AI for Educators' and 'Study Mode' to help teachers support active, step-by-step learning by enabling students to think and learn effectively through question-based interactions.

learning.title: DevFest 2026 is Back for Agentic AI Era Development
learning.summary: Google announced the return of DevFest 2026, a global series of over 800 events designed to help developers connect, build, secure, and scale their solutions, particularly in the evolving agentic AI era.
